title: Owen Lars
description: Owen Lars was already a young adult when his father, Cliegg, married Shmi Skywalker. He and his girlfriend, Beru Whitesun, met her son, Anakin, once when he tried to save her from the Tusken Raiders, leaving as quickly as he came. Obi-Wan Kenobi delivered Anakin's son Luke to Owen and Beru, and they adopted the boy and raised him as their own. Owen was fiercely protective of his land and his family, distrusting the influence of Obi-Wan Kenobi and often warning him to stay away.
